description: Анализ метрик синхронизации: avg, min, max, RMS по master и slave узлам

targets.rawSql:
WITH current_edges AS (
  SELECT
    time,
    edge_kind,
    child_clock_id,
    child_node_id,
    parent_clock_id,
    parent_node_id
  FROM timesync.current_ptp_topology_edges
  WHERE parent_clock_id <> child_clock_id
),
resolved_edges AS (
  SELECT
    time,
    edge_kind,
    child_clock_id,
    child_node_id,
    parent_clock_id,
    parent_node_id
  FROM (
    SELECT
      current_edges.*,
      row_number() OVER (
        PARTITION BY LEAST(parent_clock_id, child_clock_id),
                     GREATEST(parent_clock_id, child_clock_id)
        ORDER BY time DESC,
                 CASE edge_kind WHEN 'observed' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
      ) AS rn
    FROM current_edges
  ) ranked
  WHERE rn = 1
),
graph_edges AS (
  SELECT
    e.time,
    e.edge_kind,
    CASE
      WHEN e.parent_node_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'node:' || e.parent_node_id::text
      ELSE 'clock:' || e.parent_clock_id::text
    END AS source,
    CASE
      WHEN e.child_node_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'node:' || e.child_node_id::text
      ELSE 'clock:' || e.child_clock_id::text
    END AS target
  FROM resolved_edges e
),
visible_edges AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (source, target)
    time,
    edge_kind,
    source,
    target
  FROM graph_edges
  WHERE source <> target
  ORDER BY source,
           target,
           time DESC,
           CASE edge_kind WHEN 'observed' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
),
active_edges AS (
  SELECT
    time,
    edge_kind,
    source,
    target
  FROM (
    SELECT
      visible_edges.*,
      row_number() OVER (
        PARTITION BY target
        ORDER BY time DESC,
                 CASE edge_kind WHEN 'observed' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
      ) AS rn
    FROM visible_edges
  ) ranked
  WHERE rn = 1
),
edge_roles AS (
  SELECT
    id,
    bool_or(is_parent) AS has_downstream,
    bool_or(is_child) AS has_upstream
  FROM (
    SELECT source AS id, TRUE AS is_parent, FALSE AS is_child
    FROM active_edges
    UNION ALL
    SELECT target AS id, FALSE AS is_parent, TRUE AS is_child
    FROM active_edges
  ) roles
  GROUP BY id
),
clock_nodes AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (id)
    id,
    title,
    clock_identity AS subtitle,
    node_id,
    has_grandmaster_kind
  FROM (
    SELECT
      CASE
        WHEN c.node_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'node:' || c.node_id::text
        ELSE 'clock:' || c.clock_id::text
      END AS id,
      COALESCE(n.hostname, c.clock_identity) AS title,
      c.clock_identity,
      c.node_id,
      c.kind = 'grandmaster' AS has_grandmaster_kind,
      c.last_seen_at
    FROM timesync.ptp_clocks c
    LEFT JOIN timesync.nodes n ON n.node_id = c.node_id
  ) clocks
  ORDER BY id,
           has_grandmaster_kind DESC,
           last_seen_at DESC,
           clock_identity
),
port_roles AS (
  SELECT
    node_id,
    bool_or(to_state = 'SLAVE') AS has_slave_port,
    bool_or(to_state = 'MASTER') AS has_master_port,
    bool_or(to_state = 'FAULTY') AS has_faulty_port,
    bool_or(to_state = 'UNCALIBRATED') AS has_uncalibrated_port,
    bool_or(to_state = 'LISTENING') AS has_listening_port
  FROM timesync.latest_ptp_port_states
  GROUP BY node_id
)
SELECT
  cn.id,
  cn.title,
  cn.subtitle,
  CASE
    WHEN COALESCE(pr.has_slave_port, FALSE) AND COALESCE(pr.has_master_port, FALSE) THEN 'boundary_clock'
    WHEN cn.has_grandmaster_kind AND COALESCE(er.has_upstream, FALSE) = FALSE THEN 'grandmaster'
    WHEN COALESCE(pr.has_slave_port, FALSE) THEN 'slave'
    WHEN COALESCE(pr.has_master_port, FALSE) THEN 'master'
    WHEN COALESCE(er.has_downstream, FALSE) AND COALESCE(er.has_upstream, FALSE) THEN 'boundary_clock'
    WHEN COALESCE(er.has_downstream, FALSE) THEN 'master'
    WHEN COALESCE(er.has_upstream, FALSE) THEN 'slave'
    WHEN COALESCE(pr.has_faulty_port, FALSE) THEN 'faulty'
    WHEN COALESCE(pr.has_uncalibrated_port, FALSE) THEN 'uncalibrated'
    WHEN COALESCE(pr.has_listening_port, FALSE) THEN 'listening'
    ELSE 'unknown'
  END AS mainstat,
  CASE WHEN cn.node_id IS NULL THEN 'unmanaged' ELSE cn.title END AS secondarystat,
  CASE
    WHEN cn.has_grandmaster_kind AND COALESCE(er.has_upstream, FALSE) = FALSE THEN 'green'
    WHEN COALESCE(pr.has_slave_port, FALSE) AND COALESCE(pr.has_master_port, FALSE) THEN 'blue'
    WHEN COALESCE(er.has_downstream, FALSE) AND COALESCE(er.has_upstream, FALSE) THEN 'blue'
    WHEN COALESCE(pr.has_master_port, FALSE) OR COALESCE(er.has_downstream, FALSE) THEN 'blue'
    WHEN COALESCE(pr.has_slave_port, FALSE) OR COALESCE(er.has_upstream, FALSE) THEN 'purple'
    WHEN COALESCE(pr.has_faulty_port, FALSE) THEN 'red'
    ELSE 'gray'
  END AS color
FROM clock_nodes cn
LEFT JOIN edge_roles er ON er.id = cn.id
LEFT JOIN port_roles pr ON pr.node_id = cn.node_id
WHERE cn.node_id IS NOT NULL
   OR er.id IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY mainstat, title

WITH current_edges AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (e.parent_clock_id, e.child_clock_id)
    e.time,
    e.edge_kind,
    e.child_clock_id,
    e.child_node_id,
    e.child_port,
    e.parent_clock_id,
    e.parent_node_id,
    e.parent_port,
    e.steps_removed,
    e.path_delay_ns
  FROM timesync.current_ptp_topology_edges e
  WHERE e.parent_clock_id <> e.child_clock_id
  ORDER BY e.parent_clock_id,
           e.child_clock_id,
           CASE e.edge_kind WHEN 'observed' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
           e.time DESC
),
resolved_edges AS (
  SELECT
    time,
    edge_kind,
    child_clock_id,
    child_node_id,
    child_port,
    parent_clock_id,
    parent_node_id,
    parent_port,
    steps_removed,
    path_delay_ns
  FROM (
    SELECT
      current_edges.*,
      row_number() OVER (
        PARTITION BY LEAST(parent_clock_id, child_clock_id),
                     GREATEST(parent_clock_id, child_clock_id)
        ORDER BY time DESC,
                 CASE edge_kind WHEN 'observed' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
      ) AS rn
    FROM current_edges
  ) ranked
  WHERE rn = 1
),
graph_edges AS (
  SELECT
    e.time,
    e.edge_kind,
    e.child_node_id AS resolved_child_node_id,
    e.child_port,
    e.path_delay_ns,
    CASE
      WHEN e.parent_node_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'node:' || e.parent_node_id::text
      ELSE 'clock:' || e.parent_clock_id::text
    END AS source,
    CASE
      WHEN e.child_node_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'node:' || e.child_node_id::text
      ELSE 'clock:' || e.child_clock_id::text
    END AS target
  FROM resolved_edges e
),
visible_edges AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (source, target)
    time,
    edge_kind,
    resolved_child_node_id,
    child_port,
    path_delay_ns,
    source,
    target
  FROM graph_edges
  WHERE source <> target
  ORDER BY source,
           target,
           time DESC,
           CASE edge_kind WHEN 'observed' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
),
active_edges AS (
  SELECT
    time,
    edge_kind,
    resolved_child_node_id,
    child_port,
    path_delay_ns,
    source,
    target
  FROM (
    SELECT
      visible_edges.*,
      row_number() OVER (
        PARTITION BY target
        ORDER BY time DESC,
                 CASE edge_kind WHEN 'observed' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
      ) AS rn
    FROM visible_edges
  ) ranked
  WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT
  e.source || '->' || e.target AS id,
  e.source,
  e.target,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(ps.interface, ''), NULLIF(child_node.interface, ''), e.edge_kind) AS mainstat,
  COALESCE(e.path_delay_ns::text || ' ns', e.edge_kind) AS secondarystat,
  CASE e.edge_kind WHEN 'observed' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END AS thickness,
  CASE e.edge_kind WHEN 'observed' THEN 'green' ELSE 'gray' END AS color
FROM active_edges e
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT port_state.interface
  FROM timesync.latest_ptp_port_states port_state
  WHERE port_state.node_id = e.resolved_child_node_id
  ORDER BY CASE
             WHEN port_state.port = e.child_port THEN 0
             WHEN port_state.to_state = 'SLAVE' THEN 1
             ELSE 2
           END,
           port_state.time DESC
  LIMIT 1
) ps ON TRUE
LEFT JOIN timesync.nodes child_node ON child_node.node_id = e.resolved_child_node_id
ORDER BY source, target

WITH last_before AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (n.hostname, e.port)
    $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AS time,
    n.hostname || ' port ' || e.port::text || ' (' || COALESCE(e.interface, '') || ')' AS series,
    e.to_state
  FROM timesync.ptp4l_port_events e
  JOIN timesync.nodes n ON n.node_id = e.node_id
  WHERE e.time < $__timeFrom()
    AND n.hostname ~ '${node:pipe}'
    AND e.port > 0
  ORDER BY n.hostname, e.port, e.time DESC
)
SELECT
  e.time,
  n.hostname || ' port ' || e.port::text || ' (' || COALESCE(e.interface, '') || ')' AS series,
  e.to_state
FROM timesync.ptp4l_port_events e
JOIN timesync.nodes n ON n.node_id = e.node_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(e.time)
  AND n.hostname ~ '${node:pipe}'
  AND e.port > 0

UNION ALL

SELECT time, series, to_state FROM last_before

ORDER BY time, series

SELECT
  n.hostname,
  COALESCE(r.inferred_role, 'unknown') AS type,
  n.type::text AS stored_type,
  n.interface,
  n.adapter_name
FROM timesync.nodes n
LEFT JOIN timesync.ptp_node_roles r ON r.node_id = n.node_id
WHERE n.hostname ~ '${node:pipe}'
ORDER BY type, n.hostname

SELECT
  $__timeGroupAlias(time,'$__interval'),
  n.hostname || ' (ptp ' || n.type::text || ')' AS metric,
  avg(offset_ns) AS "Offset (ns)"
FROM timesync.phc2sys_metrics m
JOIN timesync.nodes n ON n.node_id = m.node_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND n.hostname ~ '${node:pipe}'
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

WITH latest AS (
    SELECT node_id, MAX(time) AS max_time
    FROM timesync.quality_metrics
    WHERE sync_protocol = 'phc2sys'
    GROUP BY node_id
)
SELECT
    n.hostname               AS hostname,
    m.window_size_s::numeric AS window_size_s,
    m.mtie_ns                AS ns
FROM timesync.quality_metrics m
JOIN timesync.nodes n ON n.node_id = m.node_id
JOIN latest l ON m.node_id = l.node_id AND m.time = l.max_time
WHERE m.sync_protocol = 'phc2sys'

UNION ALL

-- G.8273.2 dTEL MTIE mask (constant temp, τ ≤ 1000s): Class B = 40 ns, Class C = 10 ns, Class D = 5 ns
SELECT
    unnest(ARRAY['G.8273.2 Class B (40 ns)', 'G.8273.2 Class C (10 ns)', 'G.8273.2 Class D (5 ns)']) AS hostname,
    w.window_size_s::numeric                                                                         AS window_size_s,
    unnest(ARRAY[40.0, 10.0, 5.0])                                                                   AS ns
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT window_size_s
    FROM timesync.quality_metrics
    WHERE sync_protocol = 'phc2sys'
) w

ORDER BY hostname, window_size_s

WITH latest AS (

-- G.8272 PRTC MTIE masks: (0.275·τ + 25) ns, clamped at 100 ns (PRTC-A) or 40 ns (PRTC-B)
SELECT
    'G.8272 PRTC-A (100 ns)'                                           AS hostname,
    w.window_size_s::numeric                                            AS window_size_s,
    LEAST(0.275 * w.window_size_s::numeric + 25.0, 100.0)::float8       AS ns
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT window_size_s
    FROM timesync.quality_metrics
    WHERE sync_protocol = 'pps'
) w

UNION ALL

SELECT
    'G.8272 PRTC-B (40 ns)'                                            AS hostname,
    w.window_size_s::numeric                                            AS window_size_s,

-- G.8272 PRTC TDEV mask (piecewise):
--   τ < 100 s  -> 3 ns
--   100 ≤ τ < 1000 s -> 0.03·τ ns
--   τ ≥ 1000 s -> 30 ns
SELECT
    'G.8272 PRTC'                                                      AS hostname,
    w.window_size_s::numeric                                            AS window_size_s,
    CASE
        WHEN w.window_size_s < 100  THEN 3.0
        WHEN w.window_size_s < 1000 THEN 0.03 * w.window_size_s::numeric
        ELSE 30.0
    END::float8                                                         AS ns
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT window_size_s
    FROM timesync.quality_metrics
    WHERE sync_protocol = 'pps'
) w

ORDER BY hostname, window_size_s

WITH ptp AS (
  SELECT
    $__timeGroup(time,'$__interval') AS t,
    node_id,
    avg(offset_ns) AS offset
  FROM timesync.ptp4l_metrics
  WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
pps AS (
  SELECT
    $__timeGroup(time,'$__interval') AS t,
    node_id,
    avg(offset_ns) AS offset
  FROM timesync.pps_metrics
  WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
  GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT
  ptp.t AS time,
  n.hostname || ' (ptp ' || n.type::text || ')' AS metric,
  ptp.offset - pps.offset AS "ptp4l - PPS (ns)"
FROM ptp
JOIN pps ON pps.node_id = ptp.node_id AND pps.t = ptp.t
JOIN timesync.nodes n ON n.node_id = ptp.node_id
WHERE n.hostname ~ '${node:pipe}'
ORDER BY 1

WITH phc AS (
  SELECT
    $__timeGroup(time,'$__interval') AS t,
    node_id,
    avg(offset_ns) AS offset
  FROM timesync.phc2sys_metrics
  WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
pps AS (
  SELECT
    $__timeGroup(time,'$__interval') AS t,
    node_id,
    avg(offset_ns) AS offset
  FROM timesync.pps_metrics
  WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
  GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT
  phc.t AS time,
  n.hostname || ' (ptp ' || n.type::text || ')' AS metric,
  phc.offset - pps.offset AS "phc2sys - PPS (ns)"
FROM phc
JOIN pps ON pps.node_id = phc.node_id AND pps.t = phc.t
JOIN timesync.nodes n ON n.node_id = phc.node_id
WHERE n.hostname ~ '${node:pipe}'
ORDER BY 1

WITH samples AS (
  SELECT m.time, m.node_id, 'phc2sys'::text AS protocol, m.offset_ns
  FROM timesync.phc2sys_metrics m
  WHERE $__timeFilter(m.time)

  UNION ALL

  SELECT m.time, m.node_id, 'ptp4l'::text AS protocol, m.offset_ns
  FROM timesync.ptp4l_metrics m
  WHERE $__timeFilter(m.time)

  UNION ALL

  SELECT m.time, m.node_id, 'pps'::text AS protocol, m.offset_ns
  FROM timesync.pps_metrics m
  WHERE $__timeFilter(m.time)
)
SELECT
  $__timeGroupAlias(s.time,'$__interval'),
  n.hostname || ' (ptp ' || n.type::text || ') ' || s.protocol AS metric,
  stddev_pop(s.offset_ns::double precision) AS "СКО Offset (ns)"
FROM samples s
JOIN timesync.nodes n ON n.node_id = s.node_id
WHERE n.hostname ~ '${node:pipe}'
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2

WITH phc AS (
  SELECT
    date_trunc('minute', time) AS t,
    node_id,
    avg(offset_ns) AS offset
  FROM timesync.phc2sys_metrics
  WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
pps AS (
  SELECT
    date_trunc('minute', time) AS t,
    node_id,
    avg(offset_ns) AS offset
  FROM timesync.pps_metrics
  WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
diff AS (
  SELECT phc.node_id, phc.offset - pps.offset AS delta
  FROM phc JOIN pps ON pps.node_id = phc.node_id AND pps.t = phc.t
)
SELECT
  n.hostname,
  n.type::text AS type,
  round(avg(abs(delta))) AS "Avg abs",
  min(delta) AS "Min",
  max(delta) AS "Max",
  round(sqrt(avg(power(delta::float8, 2)))) AS "RMS"
FROM diff
JOIN timesync.nodes n ON n.node_id = diff.node_id
WHERE n.hostname ~ '${node:pipe}'
GROUP BY n.hostname, n.type
ORDER BY n.type, n.hostname
